title: REQ · AdminApp shows an error message when an execution action fails
summary: actionError state is cleared on start/success, 401 goes to handleError, other failures set the message.
description: Add actionError state to AdminApp. Clear it when an action starts or succeeds. On failure, a 401 ApiError goes to handleError; otherwise set the error message, falling back to 'Request failed'. Pass actionError to ExecutionPanel, which already renders it in a role=alert paragraph.
acceptance_criteria: Given an action responds 500 with an error body, when it completes, then the panel shows that message
Given an action fails with a non-Error value, then 'Request failed' is shown
Given an action responds 401, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token' and no actionError is shown
Given a prior failure, when a new action starts, then the old message is cleared
